ui.heroIntro: Kuramo amafoto nto ya YouTube na ako kanya mu bunyangamugayo buhanitse buhari, ubuntu. Kuramo no kubika amafoto HD kuva ku mashusho ya YouTube rusange, Shorts, canke URL ya ukanda rimwe. Shira link hepfo, kanda Fata ifoto nto, hanyuma uramure canke usangize link iteguye.

ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: Nta foto nto rusange yabonetse kuri aya mashusho.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Ikosa ry’urusobe ryahagaritse gushakisha. Ongera ugerageze.
ui.TIMEOUT: Igihe cyo gushakisha ifoto nto cyarangiye. Ongera ugerageze.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Ifoto nto ntiyashoboye kwemezwa nk’ifoto nyayo.
